prompt:
Design a square podcast cover, 1:1, that must read at 64 pixels wide.

Title, exactly: "SLOW FIELDS" in a heavy geometric sans, two stacked lines, filling the top half, in off-white. Below it, small: "a walking podcast". No other text.

Artwork: a bold flat-colour illustration of a single figure with a backpack walking along a ridge, seen from behind, against a huge low sun. Three colours only: deep forest green, burnt orange, off-white. No gradients, no photographic texture, no fine detail: every shape must survive being shrunk to an app icon.

Leave a clear margin around the title; nothing overlaps the letters.
